changelog: Delay alerts, with live parcel status: a daily Parcel delays email to the shop, off until switched on under WooCommerce → Settings → Emails (ctracking_parcel_delays, to the admin email unless recipients are given), listing parcels that newly have a delivery problem, passed their expected delivery date or went a number of days without an update from the carrier (setting Delay alerts, 5 days by default). Each reason is listed once; the job (ctracking_delay_check) reads stored statuses and makes no request. Rules in Domain\ParcelDelay; the last check's time is kept in ctracking_delays_checked, deleted on uninstall.

A parcel past its expected delivery date and not delivered shows "In transit, was expected 5 November 2026" instead of "expected" or "Arriving", on the order, the orders list, My Account, the tracking page and in emails.
